newsitem.title: UK: London tea auction sees good demand for Assams.
newsitem.headline: London tea auction sees good demand for Assams.

text.p: General demand increased at Monday's London tea auction, the official report said.
A limited offering of good liquoring Assams sold well at higher prices but values for plainer types held steady despite greater competition.
East Africans were fully firm and coloury mediums were up four to six pence.
A 2,000 package offering of Kenyan and Zimbabwe offshore teas saw improved demand and higher prices, particularly for brighter types.
